separateDecisions.note: infra/staging/docker-compose.staging.yml migrates as the postgres superuser, so EVERY object is superuser-owned there (FORCE RLS does not bind it, SECURITY DEFINER functions run as a superuser). Whether staging should migrate as flower_migrate is a broader, separate decision; SE1 is owner-independent and does not depend on it.
the Phase 1 default privileges grant S/I/U/D on every new relation to the application and platform roles; a new view re-acquires them. Whether to narrow the defaults is separate.
